title: How to retire early using compound interest and AI investing

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What if compound interest, powered by AI, could let us retire in 20 years instead of 40? How would that reshape our lives?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Today’s robo-advisors and machine learning can optimize portfolios in real time, using data from 10,000+ assets and predictive analytics.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: But if AI wealth tools become exclusive, they could deepen inequality — only the wealthy would have access to these tools and their returns.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Open-source platforms and democratized fintech are making AI investing accessible, even to those with small initial capital.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Imagine a future where AI-driven wealth tools are embedded in education, helping everyone build generational wealth from an early age.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future isn’t just about wealth — it’s about redefining time, freedom, and what it means to live well.

video_cue: A person reviewing a dashboard showing AI-managed investments growing rapidly over time.
